steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Papa, the lackeys told me to tell you all the preparations are complete.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: Is that so?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Hm? Papa, you don't seem very happy.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: How come? I thought you've been waiting for this day for a long time.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: Candela's a lot more difficult to deal with than you imagine. We mustn't let our guard down until the very last moment.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: Rafaela.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: If things look like they are about to take a turn for the worse, you make sure to get out of here with Ernesto.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Eh? I want to stay with you, Papa.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: Be a good girl and do as I say. You should never have been part of this.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: If Old Pugh found out he entrusted his daughter to me only for me to make her go through all this, he'd probably dig his way out of his grave and kill me.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: As for that brat Ernesto... Hmph...

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: What about him?

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: He thinks I can't tell how he feels, but of course I can.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: He's not trying to betray us.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: I know, and we won't see this through without him.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: But he doesn't actually want to do this himself.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Why is that?

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: Who doesn't want to just eat well, sleep well, and worry about nothing else?
Pancho reaches his hand to his adopted daughter's head and gives her a pet.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: Okay, be a good girl and bring me my pipe. I need some time alone.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Miss Ch'en, there you are.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Where's Miss Lin? I thought you two would be together.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Dropping the act already?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Now that we've come to this, there's really no reason to keep up the facade any more, is there?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I really didn't think you two could break out of my shop, though.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I guess I didn't give you enough credit.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I'm curious, though. How did you find out?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Lin Yühsia spotted your men setting up bombs during the first round. We didn't tell you, though.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: You were already suspicious of me at that point?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: As a precaution.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And our suspicions were confirmed when we found the same explosives in your store.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I didn't expect the fight to be over that soon.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: So what will you do? Will you put up a struggle, or will you turn yourself in?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I just want to say one thing, Miss Ch'en.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Perhaps you'll come to have a different opinion about all this after I'm done.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm listening.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Miss Ch'en, how familiar are you with Bolívar's history?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Can't say I know much.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Right. You studied abroad in Victoria, and Victoria hasn't really meddled in Bolívar's affairs that much. If you haven't ever gone out of your way to look into our history, I can't fault you for not being familiar with the subject.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Before Iberia discovered this place, it was nothing more than a plain called Bolívar.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: The Iberians found many Originium veins here, and that's why they decided to stay and turn it into a colony.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Then, one way or another, Iberia's rule here came to an end.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: After a period of chaos that lasted 130 years, the Leithanians came.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: And that's how Bolívar became a Leithanian dependency.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: About two centuries ago, Bolívar evolved from a dependency to a vassal state. That's the Singas dynasty.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: You could say that was when Bolívar became the Bolívar we know, although the Singas dynasty's subjects never called themselves Bolívarians.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Then, during the Witch King's reign, Leithanien tried to stir up civil unrest in Columbia through Bolívar.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: But not only did their efforts fail, Bolívar was actually invaded by Columbia, and that was when the Coalition government was established.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: And from then on, Bolívar was split between both Columbia and Leithanien.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Leithanien didn't really care about Bolívar that much, and while Columbia was teeming with ambition, Bolívar was too big for it to engulf at once.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: And that's how this tug-of-war started.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Then, unable to bear the situation any longer, the Bolívarians chose to take up arms.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: They formed a resistance movement and called themselves True Bolívarians, and they swore they would make Bolívar a real country one day.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Unfortunately, things only took a turn for the worse. True Bolívarians's establishment only dragged Bolívar into even deeper waters.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: In the end, this is the mess that Bolívar has found itself in.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: The Coalition government, the Singas dynasty, and True Bolívarians. The three sides are in a perpetual war with no end in sight.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Not only that, but this city Dossoles emerged out of the chaos.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Under Ms. Candela's management, not only is the city well-liked by all three governments, but all three of them even owe Ms. Candela many a time.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: That's because this city has resources that they can't just ignore, and Ms. Candela also has the power to defend this city.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: And so, the city has become a place that all Bolívarians set their sights on.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Every Bolívarian who's fed up with war dreams of saving up enough money to come here for a vacation, or even get a fresh start here.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Miss Ch'en, you and Miss Lin are good at heart, so I am sure you both are well aware.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Aware of what kind of a place this city is.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Let's say the three governments are still intent on uniting all of Bolívar. That's something that would never cross Ms. Candela's mind.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: To put it bluntly, Miss Ch'en, this city's prosperity was built on top of the pain and suffering of all Bolívarians.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: And the more prosperous it is, the less hope this country has.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: This is a fact that many of those who truly love Bolívar cannot accept.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And you are one of them?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I am.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: There should not be a city like this within Bolívar's borders.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Your goal is to destroy it.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: No, that would be a waste.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Our goal is to sow terror.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: So you're telling me all this to try to talk me into helping you?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Hardly. I'm not so confident that I can persuade someone to join our ranks with just a few words.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: But I am hoping you and Miss Lin could stand by and not get involved.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I am sure you can see. You can at least see how this might be justice, Miss Ch'en.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: As long as the two of you stay out of this, I can guarantee you that our men won't do a thing to you.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: You are strong. Having fought alongside you in the championship, I am well aware of that.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Fighting you would cause us a lot of unnecessary losses.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I am hoping you and Miss Lin would consider this proposal of mine.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Ernesto.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Please, go ahead.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Not long ago, I found myself caught in a conspiracy far more complicated than this one. The only thing I got out of it was the realization of my own weakness.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But, at the very least, I still dare to say this: There is no justice in spreading terror.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Besides, you aren't telling the truth.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I am not sure I follow, Miss Ch'en. I'm admitting to being the mastermind.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No, you aren't.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We're locked in your shop. That's pretty suspicious.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Effective, but also very rash, and I doubt you didn't consider the possibility that it was going to blow your cover.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: So I was thinking you might still have a trick up your sleeve.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But suppose you are the mastermind behind all this, I don't think any tricks up your sleeve could make up for your cover being blown.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Then I figured it out. If your was never that important to begin with... In other words, if getting your cover blown never mattered to you in the first place...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Then it all starts to make sense.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Your thinking is that, it would be all the better if you managed to stall us, but even if that didn't work out and you ended up getting your cover blown, all that would lead to is this situation that we find ourselves in now.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I would see you as the one behind all this, unable to get a glimpse of what's behind you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And even now, you're still playing us like a fiddle, aren't you, Ernesto?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: If you were truly being played, you'd never say as much, Miss Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We don't have enough information. I know this might be a setup, but it is one that I have to jump into.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Yet with what little clues you had, in just one short week, you almost got to the bottom of this plan we've been working on for years.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Miss Ch'en, you and Miss Lin never fail to impress.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Really, quite a lot of people tell me I'm blowing this out of all proportion by making you two my primary enemies.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: But I'm really glad I did. Otherwise, if I'd been just a little careless and let slip just a little more, you would already have it all figured out.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Too bad. You failed.
Ernesto says and turns on the TV.
